method: Three independent OpenAI Playground Responses calls; gpt-6-luna, low reasoning, standard service tier, medium verbosity, safety_new_need_v1 strict JSON schema. Store logs off; tools off. Exactly one call per case, no retries. Captured visible assistant paragraph text without editing.
